fault_states.killed: at least one baseline-passing test fails with the fault in place
fault_states.survived: the fault ran and every test still passed; this does not show whether the behaviour is untested or the change has no observable effect
fault_states.equivalent: the fault compiles to identical bytecode, so it cannot change behaviour
fault_states.unexecutable: the tests timed out with the fault in place; no verdict
